scenario: A personal auto insurance rating agent processes a driver's quote request. The pipeline extracts the driver/vehicle/usage profile from a submitted data sheet, computes a risk tier using credit-based insurance score, ZIP territory factor, and employer/occupation category, then produces a premium quote memo for the underwriter.
info_flow: csv-pipeline parses the driver profile sheet and normalizes driver attributes including ZIP code, employer/occupation category, and credit-based insurance score into a structured record → financial-calculator applies territory multipliers, occupation-tier adjustments, and credit score bands to compute a risk tier and annual base premium → ub2-markdown-report-generator compiles the risk tier, multiplier breakdown, and premium figures into a formal quote memo for the underwriter.
